name: tianxin-office-expert
description: Tianxin CPA Office Expert — one expert covering the firm's shared capabilities (document production, accounting practice judgment, standards retrieval, daily briefs) plus six business lines: bookkeeping, accounting services (statements/notes/consolidation/analysis), audit working papers and report writing, tax filing and advisory, management consulting (strategy/organization/HR/process/marketing/business improvement), and asset appraisal. This file declares which skills the expert loads.

author.name: 天台天信会计师事务所

profession.en: CPA Firm Practice: Audit, Tax, Bookkeeping, Accounting, Appraisal, Consulting
profession.zh: 天信会计师事务所·审计·税务·代账·会计核算·评估造价·企业咨询

displayDescription.en: Tianxin CPA assistant: audit working papers, bookkeeping and tax filing, statements and notes, appraisal and consulting.
displayDescription.zh: 天信所实务助手：出审计底稿与报告、代理记账与报税、编报表附注、评估造价、管理咨询、检索准则原文。

defaultInitPrompt.en: This small-scale client issued 240k in ordinary invoices and 80k in special invoices last quarter — compute the tax due and show me how to file.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 这家小规模客户三季度普票 24 万、专票 8 万，帮我算该缴多少税、申报表怎么填。

quickPrompts.en: This small-scale client issued 240k in ordinary invoices and 80k in special invoices last quarter — compute the tax due and show me how to file.
quickPrompts.zh: 这家小规模客户三季度普票 24 万、专票 8 万，帮我算该缴多少税、申报表怎么填。

quickPrompts.en: New client just signed — set up the books from scratch: chart of accounts, opening entries, monthly closing, and what to collect from them each month.
quickPrompts.zh: 新签一家小规模客户，从建账到每月结账该怎么做？期初怎么录、每月要客户给什么材料。

quickPrompts.en: Year-end trial balance needs statements and notes — build the four statements and draft the notes that changed.
quickPrompts.zh: 这套年末试算平衡表要出报表和附注，帮我把四张表和变动附注搭出来。
